## 4. Work Experience & STAR Metric-Driven Impact

### 1. Software Engineer — Mindnrobotics (May 2024 – Present)
- **Shooting Range Target Control System**: **Architected a low-latency WebSockets communication protocol** between a Vue 3 dashboard and ESP32 C++ target microcontrollers over Rajant Mesh & Starlink uplinks, **achieving <15ms end-to-end hit detection latency** in field operations.
- **MindGPS Fleet Telemetry Tracker**: **Designed a scalable Node.js TCP ingestion engine** to parse raw binary telemetry streams from Teltonika FMC920 GPS devices, **maintaining steady 500+ pkts/sec ingestion into PostgreSQL with 99.9% pipeline uptime**.
- **CanopyNet Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) Dashboard**: **Engineered an interactive mobile robot fleet dashboard** using Vue 3 and Leaflet.js, integrating ROS 2 telemetry feeds to deliver real-time spatial positioning for autonomous plantation UGVs.

### 2. IT Programmer / Intern — PKT Logistics Group (Aug 2023 – Mar 2024)
- **Enterprise Security & E-Claim Platform**: **Developed and integrated enterprise internal portals** (Security Access, E-Claim, WMS Vendor API) using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS, **streamlining operational workflows for over 1,000 active employees and logistics partners**.

## 5. Tiered Engineering Builds Showcase (18 Production Builds)

### Tier 1: Enterprise & Industrial IoT Systems (Flagship Builds)
1. **Shooting Range Target System** ([https://mindnrobotics.com/](https://mindnrobotics.com/)): ESP32 microcontrollers + WebSockets + Node.js + Rajant Mesh + Starlink. Sub-15ms hit latency. Pipeline: `Piezo Sensor ➔ ESP32 C++ ➔ WebSockets ➔ Rajant Mesh / Starlink ➔ Node.js ➔ Vue 3 UI`.
2. **MindGPS Telemetry Tracker** ([https://gps.mindnrobotics.com/](https://gps.mindnrobotics.com/)): Teltonika FMC920 GPS + TCP Raw Sockets + Node.js + PostgreSQL. 500+ pkts/sec ingestion. Pipeline: `Teltonika FMC920 ➔ TCP Raw Socket ➔ Byte Parser ➔ Worker Ingestion ➔ PostgreSQL ➔ Leaflet GIS`.
3. **CanopyNet UGV Dashboard** ([https://canopynet.mindnrobotics.com/](https://canopynet.mindnrobotics.com/)): Vue 3 + Leaflet + ROS + Field UGV tracking. Pipeline: `UGV Hardware Sensors ➔ ROS Robot Engine ➔ WebSocket Bridge ➔ Vue 3 + Leaflet GIS`.
4. **PKT Security & E-Claim Portal** ([https://hazman.dev/eclaim](https://hazman.dev/eclaim)): Vue.js + Tailwind + WMS API + CCTV Access Controls. Streamlined workflows for 1,000+ users.

### Tier 2: Full-Stack Web Applications
5. **Interactive Org Chart Builder** ([https://hazman.dev/org-demo](https://hazman.dev/org-demo)): Vue 3 + TypeScript + D3 Org Chart + Cloudflare D1. Drag-and-drop hierarchy builder.
6. **MediSaaS Clinic System** ([https://demo-clinic-management-system.vercel.app/](https://demo-clinic-management-system.vercel.app/)): Vue.js + Tailwind + Vercel multi-doctor queue system.
7. **Tasmik Progress Management System** ([http://[2001:f40:935:99c:6806:fc47:e2f3:97e7]:5175](http://[2001:f40:935:99c:6806:fc47:e2f3:97e7]:5175)): Student progress tracker + Supabase.
8. **Restaurant POS System** ([https://demo-restaurant-ordering-system.vercel.app/](https://demo-restaurant-ordering-system.vercel.app/)): Vue.js + Firebase POS.
9. **SmashPoint Badminton Booking** ([https://smashpoint.vercel.app/](https://smashpoint.vercel.app/)): React + Firebase court reservation app.
10. **QR Memories** ([https://qrmemories.pages.dev/login](https://qrmemories.pages.dev/login)): Digital memory lane photo scanner app.

### Tier 3: Tools & Micro-Apps
11. **EZQRCode Manager** ([https://ezqrcode.pages.dev/](https://ezqrcode.pages.dev/)): Dynamic QR generator + Vite + Tailwind.
12. **EZresit Receipt Manager** ([https://ezresit.pages.dev/](https://ezresit.pages.dev/)): Serverless receipt manager + Nuxt + Cloudflare Pages.
13. **Confession Bot** ([https://confess-bot.pages.dev/](https://confess-bot.pages.dev/)): Discord.js + Node.js anonymous message bot.
14. **TravThru Premium Chauffeur** ([https://www.travthru.com/](https://www.travthru.com/)): Production client website with SEO optimization.
15. **Birthday Wish Creator** ([https://hazman.dev/birthday/create](https://hazman.dev/birthday/create)): Multi-user wish generator + Supabase.
16. **Global Photo Collection** ([https://hazman.dev/photocollection](https://hazman.dev/photocollection)): Travel photo showcase + Cloudflare R2.
17. **WiFi QR Code Generator** ([https://hazman.dev/wifi-qr](https://hazman.dev/wifi-qr)): Instant printable Wi-Fi QR generator tool.
18. **Social Copywriting Generator** ([https://hazman.dev/caption](https://hazman.dev/caption)): Interactive caption copy assistant tool.

## 8. Complete Official Resume Transcript (Hazman's-resume-july-2026.pdf)

### Executive Summary
Motivated Full-Stack & IoT Systems Engineer holding a Bachelor of Computer Science (Maritime Informatics) from UMT and a Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from PIS. Proven track record in developing full-stack web applications (Vue.js, React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS), embedded target controllers (ESP32 C++ firmware), vehicle telemetry trackers (Teltonika FMC920 TCP ingestion + PostgreSQL), and industrial field network infrastructures (Rajant Kinetic Mesh + Starlink satellite uplinks). Fast learner with strong analytical skills, adept at building scalable full-stack solutions and field-ready IoT systems.

### Education Background
1. **Bachelor of Computer Science with Maritime Informatics**
   - *Institution*: Universiti Malaysia Terengganu (UMT)
   - *Period*: 2019 – 2024
   - *Honors*: Dean's List (Semesters 2, 3, and 4)
   - *Final Year Project*: Misz Home Appointment System — Comprehensive online booking & queue management portal.

2. **Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering**
   - *Institution*: Politeknik Ibrahim Sultan (PIS)
   - *Period*: 2015 – 2018
   - *Focus*: Embedded Systems, Circuit Logic, Microcontrollers, Industrial Electronics.

### Detailed Professional Experience

#### 1. Software Engineer — Mindnrobotics (May 2024 – Present)
- **Shooting Range Target Control System**: Architected a low-latency WebSockets communication protocol between a Vue 3 dashboard and ESP32 C++ target microcontrollers over Rajant Mesh & Starlink uplinks, achieving <15ms end-to-end hit detection latency in field operations.
- **MindGPS Telemetry Tracking Platform**: Designed a scalable Node.js TCP ingestion engine to parse raw binary telemetry streams from Teltonika FMC920 GPS devices, maintaining steady 500+ pkts/sec ingestion into PostgreSQL with 99.9% pipeline uptime.
- **CanopyNet UGV Dashboard**: Engineered an interactive mobile robot fleet dashboard using Vue 3 and Leaflet.js, integrating ROS 2 telemetry feeds to deliver real-time spatial positioning for autonomous plantation UGVs.

#### 2. IT Programmer / IT Security Intern — PKT Logistics Group (Aug 2023 – Mar 2024)
- **Enterprise Security & E-Claim Platform**: Developed and integrated enterprise internal portals (Security Access, E-Claim, WMS Vendor API) using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS, streamlining operational workflows for over 1,000 active employees and logistics partners.
